AGENDA
MEETING OF

CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
Introduction of LEAD Students Attending the City Council Meeting
Presentation of Certificates of Recognition to the 2018 Puente Pride Holiday Lights Winners
Presentation by Wolf & Company, Inc. Regarding Measure M Funds
Presentation by the Los Angeles Regional Census Center Regarding Census 2020
Presentation by Alta Planning and Design Regarding the San Gabriel Valley COG Active Transportation Plan
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF FEBRUARY 12, 2019
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of February 12, 2019.
A-1 Minutes 2-12-19 CC SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING A COMPREHENSIVE SCHEDULE OF FEES AND CHARGES ASSESSED BY THE CITY FOR SERVICES AND MUNICIPAL ACTIVITIES PROVIDED TO THE PUBLIC
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing and take public testimony; and (2) adopt Resolution No. 19-5469, approving a Comprehensive Schedule of Fees and Charges for various services provided to the public.
B-1 Comprehensive Fee Schedule Staff Report
B-1 Comprehensive Fee Schedule Attachment A Resolution
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL – None
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1465
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 19-5470 approving Warrant Register No. 1465.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1465
D-2
PRESENTATION OF JANUARY 2019 REQUISITION SUMMARY REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the report.
D-2 January Requisition Report Staff Report
D-2 January Requisition Report Attachment A Report
D-3
PRESENTATION OF JANUARY 2019 INVESTMENT REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-3 January Investment Report Staff Report
D-3 January Investment Report Attachment A-E Report
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION NO. 19-5471 RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 18-5432 AND AMENDING THE COMPREHENSIVE PERSONNEL SYSTEM AND ESTABLISHING AUTHORIZED PART-TIME POSITIONS AND HOURLY RATES FOR CITY EMPLOYEES
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-5471 rescinding Resolution No. 18-5432 and approving authorized part-time positions and salary ranges.
D-4 Adjusted Salary Resolution Part Time Staff Report
D-4 Adjusted Salary Resolution Part Time Attachment A Resolution
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION NO. 19-5472 RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 18-5431 AND AMENDING THE COMPREHENSIVE PERSONNEL SYSTEM FOR FULL-TIME POSITIONS TO ADD A PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTANT AND MAINTENANCE SUPERVISOR
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-5472 rescinding Resolution No. 18-5431 and approving authorized full-time positions and salary ranges.
D-5 Adjusted Salary Resolution Full Time Staff Report
D-5 Adjusted Salary Resolution Full Time Attachment A Resolution
D-5 Adjusted Salary Resolution Full Time Attachment B Accountant
D-5 Adjusted Salary Resolution Full Time Attachment C Maint Supervisor
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF A PARK USE AGREEMENT WITH LA PUENTE SOFTBALL INC., JR. ALL AMERICAN FOOTBALL OF LA PUENTE, INC. AND BOYS AND GIRLS CLUB GUERREROS JUDO, INC. FOR THE YOUTH COALITION CARNIVAL
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Park Use Agreement for the Youth Coalition Carnival; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-6 Youth Coalition Carnival Use Agreement Staff Report
D-6 Youth Coalition Carnival Use Agreement Attachment A Agreement
D-7
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDMENT NO.1 TO THE LICENSE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE AND THE CITY OF INDUSTRY FOR THE USE OF THE PARK AND RIDE LOT
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve Amendment No. 1 to the License Agreement between the City of La Puente and the City of Industry; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-7 Industry License Agreement Amend Staff Report
D-7 Industry License Agreement Amend Attachment A Amendment
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
PRESENTATION AND CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ADOPTING ADMINISTRATIVE POLICY #60, COMPLIMENT AND COMPLAINT REPORTING PROCEDURES
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-5473 adopting a new Administrative Policy #60 establishing the City’s Compliment and Complaint Reporting Procedure.
E-1 Admin Policy 60 Compliment and Complaint Staff Report
E-1 Admin Policy 60 Compliment and Complaint Attachment A Resolution
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
